KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Kuzungumza:Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Kuzungumza:Msamiati.

2. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.

3. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.

4. When practising asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa., which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   B. Use insults to “practise” asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   C. Copy random text without understanding asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   D. Avoid reading anything related to asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..

5. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. nene
   B. zito
   C. pana
   D. fupi

6. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   C. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   D. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.

7. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.

8. When practising huyu na hawa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” huyu na hawa.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to huyu na hawa.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for huyu na hawa.
   D. Copy random text without understanding huyu na hawa.

9. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. mato
   C. watoto
   D. kitoto

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain majina and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Kuzungumza:Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
